about: Jinx's heads are League's own (restyle_native.py votes them frame by frame) with the design's eyes and mouth pasted where native_pose.py tracks the face. A head lying on its back gets no face from the paste, so dead frames 6 and 8 get closed eyes by hand: two squares for the near eye, one for the far eye, in the lash colour. import_native.py applies these edits after cutting the frames and stops if a pixel no longer has the colour an edit expects.
